summary: Community Trust Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a 22.6% increase in its quarterly cash dividend to $0.65 per share, effective with the October 1, 2026 payment to shareholders of record on September 15, 2026. The board also approved a one-time cash dividend of $0.06 per share on the same record and payment dates. No advisors were named, and no price or premium metrics apply. The company is returning capital to shareholders via recurring and special dividends. Watch for future dividend sustainability or special actions.
